title: LLM Output Evaluators
summary: This module provides various evaluators for assessing LLM outputs, including checks for JSON validity, JSON equality, and JSON schema compliance. It also defines base interfaces for different types of evaluators, such as string, pairwise string, and agent trajectory evaluators.

nodes.label: Load Evaluators
nodes.title: Load Evaluator Instances
nodes.description: Dynamically loads and configures evaluator instances based on specified types, optionally using a language model and custom configurations.

nodes.label: Validate JSON String
nodes.title: JSON Validity Checker
nodes.description: Evaluates if a given prediction string is a syntactically valid JSON object, returning a score and reasoning for invalid cases.

nodes.label: Compare JSON Objects
nodes.title: JSON Equality Checker
nodes.description: Compares a predicted JSON string against a reference JSON string for equality, optionally using a custom comparison operator.

nodes.label: Validate against JSON Schema
nodes.title: JSON Schema Validator
nodes.description: Validates a JSON prediction against a provided JSON schema, indicating whether the prediction conforms to the schema.

nodes.label: Base String Evaluator
nodes.title: Abstract String Evaluation
nodes.description: Abstract base class defining the interface for evaluators that assess single string predictions, with methods for synchronous and asynchronous evaluation.

nodes.label: Base Pairwise Evaluator
nodes.title: Abstract Pairwise String Evaluation
nodes.description: Abstract base class for evaluators that compare two string predictions, providing methods for evaluating pairs synchronously and asynchronously.

nodes.label: Base Agent Trajectory Evaluator
nodes.title: Abstract Agent Trajectory Evaluation
nodes.description: Abstract base class for evaluators designed to assess the performance and steps of an agent's execution trajectory.

nodes.label: Language Model
nodes.title: External Language Model
nodes.description: An external Language Model (LLM) used by some evaluators for generating or assessing responses.

nodes.label: JSON Schema Definition
nodes.title: External JSON Schema
nodes.description: A JSON schema definition used as a reference for validating JSON structures.

groups.label: Abstract Evaluator Interfaces
groups.title: Abstract Evaluator Interfaces
groups.description: Defines the base contracts for different types of evaluators.

groups.label: Evaluator Factories
groups.title: Evaluator Factories
groups.description: Components responsible for creating and configuring evaluator instances.

groups.label: JSON Parsing Evaluators
groups.title: JSON Parsing Evaluators
groups.description: Specialized evaluators for validating and comparing JSON structures.
